messages:
Marta L: Heads-up for anyone heading to Lisbon conf — quick questions: do you bring a pocket Wi‑Fi, buy a local SIM, or just use an eSIM? Also thinking of driving up from Faro vs train. Thoughts?
Diego V: eSIM for me. quick to set up and no physical SIM swap. bought an Airalo plan last time, decent speed.
Hannah K: Pocket Wi‑Fi if you need lots of hotspotting for booth stuff, otherwise eSIM or local SIM. eSIM sometimes cheaper prebooked.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: company will reimburse preapproved connectivity rentals (pocket Wi‑Fi) and SIMs if tied to event travel. Submit receipts to Expenses within 30 days.
Ola P: Driving from Faro is scenic but parking in Lisbon conference district is pricey and a pain. Train is ~2.5h and drops you near the hotel. I'd do train.
Marta L: Good to know re: parking. Anyone ship swag to hotel before arrival? worried about customs and lost boxes.
Diego V: Ship to hotel concierge but mark as "Attn: [Your name], Conference" and include tracking. buy return labels if you're worried. Customs was fine for small promo stuff.
Hannah K: For adapters: Europe is type C mostly but some older outlets. carry a compact 2‑prong EU adapter + USB-C PD charger and you're golden.
Ola P: Packing tip: compressible toiletry bag and a small laundry pack. we had midnight swaps last year and it saved the day.
Marta L: Awesome, will do eSIM + train unless others object. I'll ping People Ops for preapproval for a pocket Wi‑Fi if booth routing changes. Thanks!
